metadata.activityName: Input results into personal health tracking application

rows.Annotations: Since the blood pressure (BP) reading is high, input further information about the client's behaviour and environment immediately prior to and during the time when the measurement was taken. These factors can affect BP levels and how the measurement data are interpreted. Data on current symptoms are input to provide additional context for the measurement and to track any concerning symptoms.
rows.Outputs: Contextual data for measurement required is True
rows.Reference(s):
WHO technical specifications for automated non-invasive blood pressure measuring devices with cuff (2020) (1)    

WHO guidelines for managing complications in pregnancy and childbirth (2017) (3)

rows.Annotations: Your blood pressure is controlled, so continue taking all the steps to control and monitor it. You and your family should continue to watch for the danger signs of pregnancy even though your blood pressure is not high.
rows.Output: Continue SMBP and watch carefully for danger signs
